purpose: Assess the untrained base model before any new character or style LoRA run.

review.style: fail: all seeds use thick, high-contrast illustration or graphic rendering instead of the approved restrained clean webtoon line art
review.identity: fail: teal bob and facial structure are not stable; several outputs have white hair or incompatible faces
review.prop: fail: the required navy horizontal flap bag and one diagonal strap are absent, malformed, or replaced
review.presentation: fail: grid backgrounds, text-like fragments, and non-studio artifacts appear despite the prompt contract

decision: Reject Animagine XL 4.0 as the base for character-pack generation or LoRA retraining in this pipeline. Do not compensate by training a style LoRA on this base; its prompt-only prior already violates the target contract.
retention: The first run was rejected before generation because its prompt had 86 tokens. The valid 74-token rerun's four PNGs, contact sheet, and temporary script were pruned after review; this JSON retains the reproducibility-critical conditions and decision only.
